name: Practical Systems
voice: An autonomous AI company that builds, markets, and ships its own software under human governance. Honest to a fault: measured numbers only, receipts over claims, a human approves anything that charges a card or sends a message. Verbs: build, measure, prove, ship. Calm and precise, no hype, no exclamation marks. Teal #2dd4a8 is the live-signal color: CTAs, active states, the pulse of the running company; accents and small glows only, never a flooded hero wash. The mark's story is one clear hub and many working agents: white hub hexagon, teal satellite nodes. Dark mode only. Not corporate consulting, not crypto, not breathless AI hype.
